posts.body_html:
I scored two IBV seedlings from Mike and I thought I'd do a line-up with an "OG" BV clone. The left and center plants are IBV, and the plant on the right is BV Clone B. All these pitchers opened facing north for some reason, so the veins on the tubes can actually be a lot stronger than they appear here. Photos taken 5/22

Black Veins and Spawn of Black Veins! lol Its hard to tell in the pic, but the immature seedlings are already a couple inches taller than the Clone B and it will be interesting to see at what height these new plants top out.
